style: From the reference picture, draw only the one object named below, alone and whole, so it can be turned into a 3D model. Keep its exact shape, colours and glossy iridescent style. Nothing else: no ghost, no head, no body, no hands, no shadow, no text. Three-quarter view from slightly above, centred, filling most of the frame, on a plain pure white background.

ideas.label: Object
ideas.prompt: the hair bun on top of the head: a round bun of puffed ribbed sections, like a small pumpkin, with a small twisted knot on top. Seen whole, with its flat underside where it sat on the head.

ideas.label: Object
ideas.prompt: the silk neck scarf: a closed loop of rolled patterned silk, as if still tied round a neck, with the knot and two pointed tails hanging at the front. Same print and colours as in the picture.
